claim_being_audited: Whether the model can be certified now on the basis of aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents while the aviation maintenance triage weakness remains unresolved, on the theory that the limitation can be transparently disclosed and managed post-certification.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence shows the unresolved aviation maintenance triage limitation has actually been disclosed for the named launch use case.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Final model card or launch documentation explicitly disclosing the limitation, or equivalent admissible disclosure record.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy requires disclosure unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance; without evidence of disclosure, current certification support is incomplete.

concern_ledger.concern: Mitigation evidence is only a draft runbook with missing governance fields.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Final approved mitigation/runbook with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy text says draft runbooks and future monitoring do not remove the disclosure requirement unless approved; missing owner/threshold also prevents treating mitigation as approved support for caveat-free certification.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence of approved risk acceptance.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Signed or otherwise admissible approval record for risk acceptance covering this limitation and launch use case.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Approved risk acceptance is one of the policy-recognized paths if a material limitation remains unresolved and disclosure/resolution is not otherwise complete.

concern_ledger.concern: The current record still contains a statement that there are no known material limitations despite evidence of an unresolved slice issue.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Updated final model card or adjudicated materiality determination reconciling the unresolved issue with the disclosure statement.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: This creates a direct inconsistency in the launch record and undermines the actor's claim that the limitation is being transparently handled.

decision_criteria: Policy requires either current evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion for certification without material caveats.
Release policy separately requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents are supportive but do not by themselves negate a known unresolved slice-specific weakness.
evidence_requests: Evidence that the aviation maintenance triage limitation has been formally disclosed in the model card or equivalent launch documentation for the named use case.
Approved risk-acceptance record, if disclosure is not the chosen path.
Final mitigation/runbook artifact showing owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Materiality determination showing the unresolved slice is not a material limitation for the named launch use case, if that is the intended argument.
specific_concerns: Current admissible evidence shows a remaining below-target weakness in a named launch use case slice, so the record does not support certification without a material caveat.
The mitigation artifact is only a draft runbook and lacks required governance elements noted in policy: accountable owner and alert threshold; no review date is evidenced either.
The record does not show an approved risk acceptance.
The record does not show that the material limitation has actually been disclosed in the model card or launch record; instead, the draft says there are no known material limitations.

Actor's recommendation to certify_model overreaches the present record because the strongest supported position is conditional certification only after disclosure or approved acceptance is actually evidenced.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently supportable on the present record, rather than only conditionally supportable if the unresolved limitation is formally disclosed or covered by approved risk acceptance.
That the current packet establishes compliance with the policy threshold for certification without material caveats.
Any implication that draft monitoring/runbook materials remove the current disclosure requirement.
